Had a strong mashed potato flavour. ``` ## Review Visited on the recommendation of our tour guide. It was my first time having Greek food, so I had no idea what to order — I just went with the guide's suggestions: Souvlaki and Homemade Moussaka. The Souvlaki was like a Greek-style kebab — lamb wrapped in pita bread. The lamb was tender and really good. The Moussaka had a layered structure like lasagna, with a surprisingly strong mashed potato flavour. It was unlike anything I'd tasted before, but I enjoyed it without any hesitation. Overall a satisfying meal. ## Pictures
